question: Sum of NNA_IN flows by ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID in FY26-Q1
reference_sql: SELECT f.ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID, round(sum(CASE WHEN f.DW_TRAN_DIRCTN_CD = 'O' THEN -f.TRAN_AM ELSE f.TRAN_AM END), 2) FROM TRAN_FACT_1 f JOIN MONTH_DIM_1 m ON m.CLDR_EOM_DT = last_day(f.DW_TRAN_DT) WHERE f.CURR_IN = 1 AND m.CLDR_EOM_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-30' AND DATE '2025-06-30' AND f.NNA_IN = 'Y' AND m.DW_BRKRG_MNTH_FRM_TODAY_CT <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACCT_DIM2_1 t WHERE t.DW_ACCT_ID = f.DW_ACCT_ID AND t.SRCE_SYS_ID = f.ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID AND t.TEST_ACCT_IN = 'Y') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NNA_EXCL_1 x WHERE x.DW_ACCT_ID = f.DW_ACCT_ID AND x.SRCE_SYS_CD = CASE f.ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID WHEN 100 THEN 'BROKERAGE' WHEN 200 THEN 'BANK' END AND f.DW_TRAN_DT BETWEEN x.EXCL_EFF_DT AND coalesce(x.EXCL_EXPR_DT, DATE '9999-12-31')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: NNA for FY26-Q1 by BRCH_CD
reference_sql: SELECT o.BRCH_CD, round(sum(CASE WHEN f.DW_TRAN_DIRCTN_CD = 'O' THEN -f.TRAN_AM ELSE f.TRAN_AM END), 2) FROM TRAN_FACT_1 f JOIN MONTH_DIM_1 m ON m.CLDR_EOM_DT = last_day(f.DW_TRAN_DT) JOIN ACCT_DIM2_1 a ON a.DW_ACCT_ID = f.DW_ACCT_ID AND a.SRCE_SYS_ID = f.ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID AND a.CURR_IN = 1 JOIN HSHLD_DIM_1 h ON h.HSHLD_DK = a.HSHLD_DK JOIN ADV_DIM_1 ad ON ad.ADV_ID = h.PRIM_ADV_ID JOIN BRCH_DIM_1 o ON o.BRCH_CD = ad.BRCH_CD AND o.CURR_IN = 1 WHERE f.CURR_IN = 1 AND m.CLDR_EOM_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-30' AND DATE '2025-06-30' AND f.NNA_IN = 'Y' AND m.DW_BRKRG_MNTH_FRM_TODAY_CT <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACCT_DIM2_1 t WHERE t.DW_ACCT_ID = f.DW_ACCT_ID AND t.SRCE_SYS_ID = f.ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID AND t.TEST_ACCT_IN = 'Y') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NNA_EXCL_1 x WHERE x.DW_ACCT_ID = f.DW_ACCT_ID AND x.SRCE_SYS_CD = CASE f.ACCT_SRCE_SYS_ID WHEN 100 THEN 'BROKERAGE' WHEN 200 THEN 'BANK' END AND f.DW_TRAN_DT BETWEEN x.EXCL_EFF_DT AND coalesce(x.EXCL_EXPR_DT, DATE '9999-12-31')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
